generation.scope: At opposite rank eight all-degree regularity is decidable for finite Frobenius windows with a planar mark whose maximal ideal has principal square. Thus the untested finite stratum has at most three closed points, each a nonstretched planar Gorenstein local ring of length at least six. The proof handles both types of length-three slices and all length-four slices at the mark.

open_mathematics: Study the remaining finite rank-eight windows on at most three nonstretched planar local factors, using their second fundamental forms, support bounds, and embedded line sections. Work also on the rank-nine branching obstruction.
